walls.wall: Heikhal rear (west, Kodesh partition) inner face

sourceReference: Yechezkel 41:18-20: keruvim and palms alternate; each keruv has a man's face and a young lion's face. The image renders that layout as one repeating unit; its full bodies and wings are artistic interpretation (CLAUDE-VISUAL-ASSETS.md).

seam.rule: ratio near 1 = the repeat joint is as smooth as neighbouring columns; >> 1 = visible seam

parameters.normalGreenConvention: directx: green encodes the component along +V (image down), the UE default (Flip Green Channel off)

image.heightIsApproximate: Derived from a lit colour render: detail = high-pass luma (lit edges read higher than shadowed edges), mass = blurred edge density. Plausible bas-relief, not measured relief.

tessellated.assignment: UNASSIGNED review material; Nanite tessellation displacement needs r.Nanite.Tessellation (default 1 in 5.8) and a Nanite mesh; unverified here

SM_KeruvFriezePanelV1.note: GeometryScript_MeshQueries.get_triangle_uvs not bound; verify orientation in a real-RHI render

SM_KeruvFriezePanelDisplacedV1.note: GeometryScript_MeshQueries.get_triangle_uvs not bound; verify orientation in a real-RHI render

SM_KeruvFriezePanelV1.convention: UE left-handed face normal cross(C-A, B-A); local +Y is the room direction after placement (yaw 0 on the -Y wall, yaw 180 on the +Y wall)

SM_KeruvFriezePanelDisplacedV1.convention: UE left-handed face normal cross(C-A, B-A); local +Y is the room direction after placement (yaw 0 on the -Y wall, yaw 180 on the +Y wall)

limitations: The frieze is an image-based relief: a generated 2D render turned into a height field. Full bodies and wings on the keruvim are the image's artistic interpretation and must be checked against the sources before final adoption (CLAUDE-VISUAL-ASSETS.md).

Height is approximate: high-pass luma of a lit render, background clamped by a histogram estimate. Lit edges read higher than shadowed edges. displacementCm 3 and the 250 cm module are artistic choices.
The image repeats horizontally by design and not vertically; stacking 8 rows repeats the panel as tiles with a visible horizontal joint at every 250 cm.
Textures, materials, meshes and placement are geometric and graph-level only; no visual, shader-compile, Nanite, lighting, performance or packaged acceptance is established.
Traces return nothing in commandlets; rows are grounded from the measured floor component bounds, not a trace.

palmsRemoved.restoreRule: spawn StaticMeshActor per entry with mesh, pose, folder, tags, NoCollision; or copy the checkpoint back

clearance.excludedTerrainRule: terrain tile AABBs (400-800 m) enclose the Heikhal; surfaces lie far below Z 925
